newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer-Special factors boosting consumer price.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-Special factors boosting consumer price.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that consumer price inflation in Germany was being boosted by seasonal factors.
Asked about the development of consumer prices, Tietmeyer said that data were being impacted by special factors, "in particular seasonal factors".
Tietmeyer added, however, that he did not see any significant upward trend in inflation. He was speaking to reporters after a Bundesbank news conference.
